title: GET /api/compare 200
description: One query ranked twice, under two named weightings of the relevance branches, with the first ten of each side and the movement between them. A pre-v1 endpoint, described here unchanged. a defaults to served and b to previous. A missing or over-long q, or a profile name outside the three, is a 400, error.json.

q.description: The trimmed query, at most 256 characters.

window.description: How many ranked cards each side holds at most.

deltas.description: The union of the two windows, largest movement first. A card only one window holds comes before every card both hold.

spearman_rho_union.description: Spearman's rank correlation over the union, rounded to four decimals; 1 is the same ranking and -1 the reverse. null when it is undefined: fewer than two cards in the union, or a side that matched nothing.

missing_rank.description: The rank a card takes in the window that does not hold it, when the correlation is computed: window + 1.

side.description: One profile's answer: the weights it was given, and its ranked window.

boosts.description: The boost each relevance branch carried in the request that was sent, keyed by branch name.

total.description: Cards matching the query, not only the window.

results.description: Ranked best first, ranks 1, 2, 3, ... without gaps; scores never increase down the list.

delta.description: One card of the union. status is entered when only b holds it (rank_a and delta are null), dropped when only a holds it (rank_b and delta are null), and otherwise up, down or same by the sign of delta, with all three numbers present.
rank_a - rank_b: positive means the card is nearer the top under b.
